verdict.rationale: Poke documents an official API for sending messages programmatically from apps, scripts, and automation tools. It also ships an official npm-distributed CLI (`npx poke@latest` for login, tunneling, and adding MCP servers), so there is first-party programmatic tooling to build against. However, nothing in the evidence describes an actual language SDK or client library, and probes found no OpenAPI spec to generate one from. Missing for 10: documented official SDKs/client libraries in any language, SDK reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of SDK use.
